Name: Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls Desaturated
Author: cherlinn
Description:
This mod does nothing on its own. I've only included the recolored image PNGs, which should replace donutbunnybunny's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31792]original mod files[/url].

To do this, after installing Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls for Vanilla, navigate to "Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Seasonal Doghouses and Pet Bowls\assets" and replace the images.
